query: A capacitor has capacitance C = 47 μF and is connected to a potential difference U = 12 V. Calculate the energy stored in the capacitor.
A capacitor stores a charge Q = 2.4 mC when connected to a voltage U = 16 V. Calculate the capacitance of the capacitor.
Two point charges q1 = +3.0 μC and q2 = -5.0 μC are separated by a distance of 0.30 m in air. Calculate the magnitude of the electrostatic force between them. Use k = 9.0 × 10^9 N·m²/C².
Two charges +4.0 nC and -4.0 nC are fixed 20 cm apart in air. Calculate the magnitude of the electric field at the midpoint between the charges. Use k = 9.0 × 10^9 N·m²/C².
A point P is 10 cm from a charge q1 = +6.0 nC and 20 cm from a charge q2 = -2.0 nC. Calculate the electric potential at P. Use k = 9.0 × 10^9 N·m²/C².
Two capacitors C1 = 6.0 μF and C2 = 3.0 μF are connected in series across an 18 V battery. Calculate the charge stored on each capacitor.
A 24 Ω resistor is connected to a 12 V battery for 5 minutes. Calculate the electrical energy converted in the resistor.
Two resistors R1 = 12 Ω and R2 = 18 Ω are connected in series to a 15 V source. Calculate the current in the circuit.
Two resistors R1 = 6 Ω and R2 = 3 Ω are connected in parallel across a 12 V source. Calculate the total current drawn from the source.
An LC circuit has inductance L = 0.20 H and capacitance C = 50 μF. Calculate the resonant frequency of the circuit.
An inductor with inductance L = 0.40 H is connected to an AC source of frequency f = 60 Hz. Calculate the inductive reactance.
A car starts with an initial speed of 8 m/s and travels 66 m in 6 s with constant acceleration. Calculate the acceleration of the car.
A car moving at 20 m/s brakes uniformly to rest with acceleration -4.0 m/s². Calculate the braking distance.
A person of mass 60 kg stands in an elevator accelerating upward at 1.5 m/s². Calculate the normal force exerted by the elevator floor on the person. Use g = 9.8 m/s².
A 2.0 kg object starts from rest. A constant net force of 10 N acts on it over a distance of 5.0 m. Calculate the final speed of the object.
A ball is thrown vertically upward with an initial speed of 19.6 m/s. Calculate the maximum height reached by the ball. Use g = 9.8 m/s².
How much heat is required to raise the temperature of 0.50 kg of water by 15 °C? Use c = 4200 J/(kg·°C).
Calculate the heat required to melt 0.20 kg of ice at 0 °C. Use the latent heat of fusion of ice L = 3.34 × 10^5 J/kg.
A gas sample contains n = 0.50 mol at temperature T = 300 K in a volume V = 0.010 m³. Calculate the pressure of the gas. Use R = 8.314 J/(mol·K).
An object is placed 30 cm in front of a converging lens with focal length 20 cm. Calculate the image distance.
A lamp carries current I = 0.25 A under voltage U = 12 V. Calculate its power.
A charge q = 3 uC moves through a potential difference U = 5 V. Calculate the work done.
A conductor has length l = 2 m, cross-sectional area S = 1 mm^2, and resistivity rho = 0.5 ohm*mm^2/m. Calculate its resistance.
A transformer has primary turns N1 = 200, secondary turns N2 = 800, and primary voltage U1 = 12 V. Calculate the secondary voltage.
A resistor dissipates P = 9 W when the current is I = 3 A. Calculate its resistance.
